# infrawrench_cost_report_notification (Resource)

A recurring delivery of one `infrawrench_cost_report` to Slack, Teams or email.

At least one destination is required: a schedule with nowhere to deliver would only ever record failures. The report itself decides what window it charts — the cadence here only decides how often it is sent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cadence` (String) How often the schedule fires. One of `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`.
- `cost_report_id` (String) The report to send. Changing it replaces the schedule — the route is nested under the report, so there is nothing to move.
- `hour` (Number) Local hour (0–23) in `timezone` the delivery fires at.
- `timezone` (String) IANA zone, e.g. `Europe/Berlin`. Validated server-side.

### Optional

- `email_recipients` (List of String) Email addresses, at most 20. Lowercased server-side.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`. A disabled schedule keeps its settings and never fires.
- `send_day` (Number) ISO day of week (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday). Read only when `cadence` is `weekly`.

Computed as well as optional because the server stores a default in the column whatever the cadence is, and reads back null here for any cadence that does not use it.
- `send_day_of_month` (Number) Day of month, 1–31. Read only when `cadence` is `monthly`. A day the month doesn't have clamps to its last day, so 31 means month end everywhere.
- `slack_channel_ids` (List of String) Stored Slack channel row ids to post to — the `id` of an `infrawrench_slack_channel`, not a Slack `C…` id.
- `teams_webhook_ids` (List of String) Stored Teams webhook ids to post to, from `infrawrench_msteams_webhook`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned notification id. Import addresses it as `<cost_report_id>/<id>`, because the notification's own id is not enough to build its URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A notification hangs off its report, so the notification id alone cannot
# build a URL. The address is <cost_report_id>/<notification_id>.
terraform import infrawrench_cost_report_notification.weekly 7b8c9d0e-1f2a-3b4c-5d6e-7f8a9b0c1d2e/3a4b5c6d-7e8f-9a0b-1c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d
```
